# Temporary integration verifier; removed before merge.
name: EOS 0.8 Core Lifecycle Reconcile

on:
  push:
    branches: [eos/v0.8-program-adoption]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/eos-v08-core-lifecycle-reconcile.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  reconcile:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Reconcile canonical lifecycle states
        run: |
          python3 scripts/sync-eos-lifecycle-model.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-eos-lifecycle-model.py
      - name: Verify EOS 0.8 adoption contract
        run: python3 scripts/test-eos-0.8-program-adoption.py
      - name: Verify EOS strictly
        run: ./scripts/eos verify --strict
      - name: Synchronize machine documents
        run: |
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
      - name: Commit canonical reconciliation
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet --exit-code; then
            exit 0
          fi
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .eos/domain-model.json .eos/schemas/core/pi.schema.json .eos/schemas/core/wc.schema.json .eos/schemas/core/wp.schema.json machine
          git commit -m "fix(eos): align canonical lifecycle states with 0.8"
          git push origin "HEAD:eos/v0.8-program-adoption"
